title: Exact five-uniformity of F2,u from q = 4027
summary: Prove or refute exact differential uniformity five for every admissible Mesnager--Wu binomial above the experimentally observed field-size threshold.

formal_statement.body: Let $q=p^n\ge 4027$ be an odd prime power with $q\equiv3\pmod 4$, let $\eta$ be the quadratic character of $\mathbb F_q$, and define $F_{2,u}(x)=x^2(1+u\eta(x))$. Set $U=\{0,\pm1\}$ when $p=3$ and $U=\{0,\pm1,\pm1/3\}$ otherwise. For every $u\in\mathbb F_q\setminus U$ satisfying $\eta(1+u)=\eta(u-1)$, must $\delta(F_{2,u})=5$?

scope.domain: Differential uniformity of odd-characteristic finite-field binomials
assumptions: $q=p^n\ge 4027$ is an odd prime power with $q\equiv3\pmod 4$
$u\notin U$, where $U=\{0,\pm1\}$ in characteristic $3$ and $U=\{0,\pm1,\pm1/3\}$ otherwise
scope.unresolved_remainder: The source proves exact differential uniformity five only for the much larger range $q\ge 27535^2$ and reports numerical evidence beginning at $q=4027$. Exact equality remains unproved for every admissible $(q,u)$ throughout the full conjectured range $q\ge 4027$.

progress.summary: The source reports numerical evidence that its exact five-uniformity theorem should hold for every admissible field order from $q=4027$, far below the proved threshold.
